name: Planar Pariah
body:
School abjuration; Level antipaladin 4, cleric/oracle 4, hunter 4, inquisitor 4, occultist 4, paladin 4, ranger 4, shaman 4, spiritualist 4, summoner 4, wizard 4

CASTING

Casting Time 1 round
Components: V, S, M/DF (lemon peel)

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target several extraplanar creatures, no two of which may be more than 30 ft. apart
Duration 1 round/level
Saving Throw Fort negates (object); Spell Resistance yes (object)

DESCRIPTION

This functions as lesser planar pariah except that the penalties are increased by 1, and it can affect any number of creatures within 30 ft. of each other, to a maximum of 12 HD in total. You choose which creatures are affected.

Planar Pariah, Lesser

School abjuration; Level antipaladin 1, cleric/oracle 1, hunter 1, inquisitor 1, occultist 1, paladin 1, ranger 1, summoner 1, shaman 1, spiritualist 1, wizard 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 round
Components: V, S, M/DF (lemon peel)

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target one extraplanar creature of up to 6 HD
Duration 1 round/level
Saving Throw Fort negates (object); Spell Resistance yes (object)

DESCRIPTION

You amplify the planar disharmonies that exist between your current plane of existence and an extraplanar creature, hampering its activities. For the duration of the spell, the creature suffers a -1 penalty on attack rolls, saving throws, skill checks and concentration checks. At caster level 8th and 16th, the penalty increases by 1.

Casting this spell impedes magic that binds a creature to this plane: if the target is confined in a magic circle or similar effect, the spell instead allows a new Charisma check to break free with a bonus equal to the penalty it applies on attack rolls. A creature that breaks free as a result of this Charisma check immediately returns to its own plane, and cannot choose to remain where it was conjured.

Planar Pariah, Greater

School abjuration; Level cleric/oracle 6, occultist 6, shaman 6, spiritualist 6, summoner 5, wizard 6

CASTING

Casting Time 1 round
Components: V, S, M/DF (lemon peel)

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target several extraplanar creatures, no two of which may be more than 30 ft. apart
Duration 1 round/level
Saving Throw Fort negates (object); Spell Resistance yes (object)

DESCRIPTION

This functions as planar pariah except that it can affect up to 18 HD of creatures, and the penalties are increased by 1.
